stories.headline: Progressive Web Components
stories.summary: Progressive Web Components I’ve worked with web components for nearly a decade and built various enterprise-scale design systems with them.  While I love what they offer on paper, the same pain points keep coming back: Layout shifts, flash of unstyled content, poor server-side rendering support, too much reliance on client side JavaScript, doesn't play well with frame­works like React Server Components, accessibility issues, and so on… Despite all of this, I still think web components are a great foundation for a design system .
